ONE REMAINING INCONSISTENCY CLASS FOUND: dashboard vs chart Entry/SL/TP can drift slightly (SUI entry 1.16054 dashboard vs 1.16014–1.16034 chart; WTI in one audit run E 90.4198 vs 90.3294) because dashboard uses a cached batch snapshot while chart recomputes from a fresh fetch — label/action/confidence always match, only ATR-derived levels drift ~0.03–0.1% with live ticks.

minor.issue: Entry/SL/TP (and last price) can differ slightly between dashboard and detail for the same asset+TF+profile (SUI crypto reproduced 2x, persistently; WTI commodity in 1 audit run). Root cause: dashboard computes from cached batch snapshot (TTL cache / Yahoo spark batch) while chart endpoint refetches per-symbol (Binance fresh / Yahoo v8 chart) — live price ticks shift ATR-derived levels. Label/action/confidence are stable and consistent everywhere. Audit rule 'Entry/SL/TP HARUS identik' is therefore intermittently violated.

critical_code_review_comments: ROOT CAUSE of residual drift: server.py asset_chart/asset_analyze call get_stock_snapshot/get_crypto_snapshot per request (fresh), while _build_dashboard_response uses cached batch snapshots (v7 spark for Yahoo markets, TTL-cached). Two snapshot sources → same formula, different input candles → different ATR levels. This is the same architectural seam that caused the original LONG-vs-SIDEWAYS bug; direction is now aligned (single compute_signal + default TF 1h) but numeric levels still diverge at the seam.

rca_of_issue: Residual inconsistency RCA: (1) Reproduce — pytest test_crypto_label_conf_levels_match[SUI] fails repeatedly: dashboard entry=1.16053571 (stable, cached) vs chart entry=1.16013571→1.16033571 (moves with live ticks). WTI showed dash price 89.97 vs chart price 89.88 with E 90.4198 vs 90.3294 in audit run. (2) Root cause — dashboard path (_build_dashboard_response) computes signals from TTL-cached batch snapshots (Binance batch / Yahoo v7 spark), while detail path (asset_chart/asset_analyze, server.py:1187-1204) calls get_crypto_snapshot/get_stock_snapshot which fetch fresh per-symbol data (Yahoo v8 chart / Binance klines). compute_signal is identical, but its INPUT candles/last price differ → ATR-derived Entry/SL/TP differ by ~0.03-0.1%. Direction (action/label) and confidence pass gates on both inputs so they stay consistent — which is why the user's primary complaint is resolved. (3) Mitigation — share one snapshot cache between dashboard and chart paths keyed by (symbol, timeframe), or include the snapshot timestamp in dashboard responses and have the detail page/API reuse the cached snapshot while fresh. Also fix audit_consistency.py to POST /analyze (currently GET→405 silently ignored).
